أشترك (form VIII)
# أَشْتَرِكُ (ʔaštariku) /ʔaʃ.ta.ri.ku/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِشْتَرَكَ (ištaraka)
# أَشْتَرِكَ (ʔaštarika) /ʔaʃ.ta.ri.ka/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِشْتَرَكَ (ištaraka)
# أَشْتَرِكْ (ʔaštarik) /ʔaʃ.ta.rik/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِشْتَرَكَ (ištaraka)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
